raw_response.overall_narrative_summary: True full text not accessible due to a retrieval/filing PDF mismatch; no risk-of-bias appraisal of Vargas & Lima (2004) could be performed. Specifically, Study S122 (Record ID R30D282E7C071) cites Vargas MC & Lima RF (2004), 'Concessões privadas de saneamento no Brasil: bom negócio para quem?', Ambiente & Sociedade 7(2), DOI 10.1590/S1414-753X2004000200005. However, the provided 7-page PDF (SHA-256: 0563f409f138686775386cbe7b4d1d298387143f2068ce335131acc5b30beaf4) is an entirely unrelated publication: P. Cross & A. Morel (2005), 'Pro-poor strategies for urban water supply and sanitation services delivery in Africa', Water Science & Technology 51(8):51-57. Because guessing study design or bias domains from a citation/title is prohibited, paper_read is recorded as 'not accessible' and chosen_tool, overall_rating, and all seven cross-tool domains are set to 'cannot_tell'. For reconciliation completeness, if the erroneously attached Cross & Morel (2005) PDF were appraised on its own terms, it is a non-empirical programmatic policy overview and prospective three-year work plan for the World Bank Water and Sanitation Program-Africa (WSP-AF) with no completed primary data collection, no bibliography, and no systematic search, which would map to chosen_tool = 'NONE'.
raw_response.study_design_identified: cannot_tell (full text not accessible: wrong PDF retrieved; attached file is Cross & Morel 2005 in Water Science & Technology rather than Vargas & Lima 2004 in Ambiente & Sociedade)

Morel', World Bank Kenya affiliation, and footer 'Water Science & Technology Vol 51 No 8 pp 51-57 Q 2005 IWA Publishing'); prospective non-empirical work-plan nature of the misfiled PDF verified on [PDF Page 1 of 7] (Abstract) and [PDF Pages 4-6 of 7] ('Proposed action plan'). Actual text of Vargas & Lima (2004) is absent.
raw_response.why_tool_chosen: Full text of target study S122 (Vargas & Lima 2004, Ambiente & Sociedade 7(2), DOI 10.1590/S1414-753X2004000200005) is not accessible because the retrieved PDF is a misfiled copy of Cross & Morel (2005), Water Science & Technology 51(8):51-57. Per protocol, design and risk of bias must never be guessed from title/citation, requiring chosen_tool = 'cannot_tell' (whereas the misfiled Cross & Morel 2005 text itself is a non-empirical WSP-AF proposed action plan that would fit 'NONE').
